model.validity_gate: valid only if expected parent, slice_id, certificate derivation and ADVANCE derivation all match the frozen lineage identity exactly

invariants.V1_identity_gate: No nonterminal transition or recovery-to-A is evaluated until lineage validity is proven from exact expected p,slice_id,c,a. Invalid or malformed lineage input from U/C fences to F.
invariants.V2_exact_predecessor: cas1 is eligible only in U with exact P; cas2 is eligible only in C with exact S.
invariants.V3_deterministic_targets: For one valid L there is exactly one c and one a; retries cannot mint a new logical certificate or ADVANCE identity.
invariants.V4_monotone_stage: Allowed nonterminal progress is U→C→A, with U→A permitted only as observation-based recovery of already-durable same-lineage progress; C→P is regression and fences.
invariants.V5_other_descendant_fence: O never counts as own progress from U/C and always fences the lineage.
invariants.V6_terminal_absorption: Once persisted terminal A or F is reached for L, replay performs no mutation and returns the same terminal state regardless of later P/S/A/O observations; later repository drift may be separately diagnosed but cannot reopen the lineage.

bounded_leaf_result.malformed_stale_cannot_reach_A_proof: The only rules that output A from a nonterminal state are U+exact-A and C+exact-A under valid_lineage=true. valid_lineage requires exact equality of expected parent and slice_id plus deterministic recomputation of c and a. Any malformed certificate, stale parent, stale slice_id, or mismatched derived a fails the gate before observation decoding and maps U/C to F. Therefore no malformed or stale lineage input has a transition path to A in this verifier.
bounded_leaf_result.terminal_stutter_closure_proof: For every observation o in {P,S,A,O}, delta(A,o)=A and delta(F,o)=F, and both terminal actions are no-op with respect to repository mutation. Hence replay induction on any finite sequence of later observations preserves A or F exactly and cannot re-enable cas1/cas2. This prevents duplicate replay after success and prevents conflict recovery from silently reopening a rejected lineage.
bounded_leaf_result.table_minimality: After the validity gate, U and C require all four exact observation classes because P and S have stage-dependent meanings while exact-A and O must remain distinguished. Terminal rows collapse to two absorbing rules independent of observation. Thus the executable core is one validity gate, eight nonterminal cells, and two terminal absorption rules.
